title: Metal-plate-connected wood trusses spanning 60 feet or greater.
officialText:
Where a truss clear span is 60 feet (18 288 mm)
or greater, the special inspector shall verify that the temporary installation restraint/bracing and the permanent individual truss
member restraint/bracing are installed in accordance with the approved truss submittal package.
